source.title: Feralas Mission VIII: Recover Keeper's Notes
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Twin Colossals. Retrieve the Mad Keeper's Notes and deliver them to me.
source.objective: Recover the Mad Keeper's Notes in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion from the east slope of the west colossal at the Twin Colossals and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
